description: This is an aerial or satellite image, likely rendered in false-colour infrared, showcasing a mountainous landscape with a prominent bright green circular point marking a specific location. In the upper left portion of the image, there is a dark blue-black body of water. The terrain is rugged, characterized by distinct ridges and valleys. Vegetation is visible in varying shades of reddish-purple, indicating dense cover possibly consisting of forest or scrubland, and lighter reddish-brown for sparser vegetation. Areas of light brown and beige suggest bare soil, rock, or very sparsely vegetated ground. The green point highlights a key location within this environment, identified by the accompanying caption as associated with alpine and subalpine grasslands. Credit: M. Rodriguez.
